title: Light switch refuses to turn dark when it's time
summary: The author supplied a basic trigger description but not the configured schedule, time zone, Light Switch mode, whether Windows theme settings change, or what the attached diagnostics show. Related open Light Switch reports exist, but the available evidence does not establish that this issue is the same as any one of them.

status.label: needs information
status.detail: Request the schedule and theme configuration plus a timestamped reproduction and diagnostic context.

judgment.rationale: The author supplied a basic trigger description but not the configured schedule, time zone, Light Switch mode, whether Windows theme settings change, or what the attached diagnostics show. Related open Light Switch reports exist, but the available evidence does not establish that this issue is the same as any one of them.
evidence: The body says scheduled switching remains light instead of becoming dark on PowerToys 0.100.2.
The only follow-up says: "turn on laptop. wait for it's time."
The issue includes a screenshot and a PowerToys report ZIP.
Related open reports include #48946 and #47566, but their titles describe different or broader Light Switch behaviors.
The issue has Needs-Team-Response and Product-LightSwitch labels with no assignee.
judgment.recommended_action: Request the schedule and theme configuration plus a timestamped reproduction and diagnostic context.

comment.body:
Please provide the Light Switch configuration and a more precise reproduction:

- The scheduled dark-theme time, light-theme time, time zone, and whether the schedule is based on fixed times or another mode.
- Whether Light Switch is enabled at startup and whether PowerToys is running elevated.
- The Windows version and current Windows Settings theme state before and after the scheduled time.
- The exact local date and time when the switch was expected, and whether the laptop was awake, asleep, or locked at that time.
- Whether manually pressing the Light Switch controls changes the theme successfully.
- A fresh bug report ZIP captured shortly after the scheduled switch fails.

Please also confirm whether this is distinct from related Light Switch reports such as #48946 or #47566.
